∀ {n : ℕ} (A : BfgsVerification.Mat n),
  Matrix.det A ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (W Z : BfgsVerification.Mat n),

        Matrix.IsSymm Z →
          ∀ (s : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (a : ℝ),
            (a •
                    (BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s * W *
                      BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s) -

                    BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector s).PosSemidef ↔
              (a •
                    (BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (Matrix.mulVec A s) *
                        (A * W * Matrix.transpose A) *
                      BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (Matrix.mulVec A s)) -
                  BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (Matrix.mulVec A s) *
                      (A * Z * Matrix.transpose A) *
                    BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.stepProjector (Matrix.mulVec A s)).PosSemidef

  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →

        ∀ (x₀ x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),

                BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹ (x - R.x 0) ∧

                  BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹
                    (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar - R.x 0) ↔

    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),

∀ {n : ℕ} {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {q δ : ℕ → ℝ} {K C : ℝ},

                              ↑m * Real.log (η + D / ↑m)) /

                    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (q (J + i))⁻¹

                      (η + D / ↑m) ^ (-↑m / ↑(m + 1)) ≤

                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature

                            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
